## Class structure

`ops:Operation_Metadata` is the global element. Every other class is a component of it, a component of another class, or a specialization.

- A filled diamond (composition) marks a component class. The label on the child end gives its occurrences within one instance of the parent.
- A hollow triangle (inheritance) marks a specialization. The specialized class adds no fields of its own.

## Controlled values

Permitted values of each `Enum` field, in the order defined in the XML.

(controlled-values-file-role)=
### `file_role`

Identifies whether the file is a PDS4 label or a data file.

Used in `File_Info`.

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `label` | The file is a PDS4 label file. |
| `data` | The data file described by a PDS4 label. |

(controlled-values-access-method)=
### `access_method`

Identifies the protocol or access mechanism associated with access_uri, or indicates that the location is intended for internal operational use.

Used in `Access_Info`.

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `https` | The URI is accessed via HTTPS. |
| `s3` | The URI is an Amazon S3 URI or compatible object-storage URI. |
| `native` | The URI is a native or system-local path. |
| `internal` | The URI is intended for internal operational use only. |

(controlled-values-representation-role)=
### `representation_role`

Identifies the role of this file representation in relation to the product.

Used in `Access_Info`.

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `primary` | The primary representation of the product. |
| `browse` | A browse or preview representation. |
| `alternate` | An alternate representation of the product. |

(controlled-values-representation-profile)=
### `representation_profile`

Identifies the intended deployment purpose or optimization of this file representation.

Used in `Access_Info`.

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `delivery` | The file is optimized for user download and delivery. |
| `cloud-native` | The file is optimized for cloud-based processing and access. |
| `preservation` | The file is in a format suitable for long-term archival retention and is the designated preservation copy. |

(controlled-values-version-status)=
### `version_status`

The class Version_Status optionally records that a product version has been superseded or withdrawn. This class is intended for these exceptional cases and should be omitted for current product versions.

Used in `Version_Status`.

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `superseded` | The product version has been replaced by a later version and is no longer the current version. |
| `withdrawn` | The product version has been withdrawn from general use or distribution. |

(controlled-values-systems-lifecycle-phase)=
### `systems_lifecycle_phase`

Identifies the phase of the Engineering Node operational workflow to which the accompanying systems_lifecycle_state applies, including preparation, ingest, review, staging, availability, or offline handling.

Used in `Systems_Lifecycle_Status`.

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `preparation` | The product is being planned, generated, documented, packaged, or otherwise prepared by a data provider for submission to PDS for archive or operational handling. |
| `ingest` | The product is being transferred from a data provider to the PDS for acceptance, harvesting, loading, and registration. |
| `review` | The product is undergoing operational, technical, or approval review. |
| `staging` | The product has been prepared for release and is staged in an operational system but is not yet publicly available online. |
| `available` | The product is made available through an operational release workflow. When systems_lifecycle_state = complete, the product is publicly available online. |
| `offline` | The product has been taken offline and is no longer publicly available through operational systems. |

(controlled-values-systems-lifecycle-state)=
### `systems_lifecycle_state`

Identifies the state of activity within the accompanying systems_lifecycle_phase, indicating whether the phase is pending, in progress, blocked, complete, or failed.

Used in `Systems_Lifecycle_Status`.

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `pending` | The lifecycle phase has not yet started. |
| `in_progress` | The lifecycle phase is currently underway. |
| `blocked` | The lifecycle phase cannot proceed until an issue, dependency, or decision is resolved. |
| `complete` | The lifecycle phase has been completed. |
| `failed` | The lifecycle phase did not complete successfully. |

(controlled-values-archive-lifecycle-state)=
### `archive_lifecycle_state`

Identifies the state of a product, collection, or bundle within the PDS archival evaluation and release process, including whether review has not begun, is underway, requires lien resolution, or has resulted in release or rejection.

Used in `Archive_Lifecycle_Status`.

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `not_reviewed` | The product has not yet entered the evaluation process. |
| `in_internal_review` | The product is undergoing an internal evaluation before formal peer review. |
| `in_peer_review` | The product is currently undergoing formal review for archival acceptance. |
| `in_lien_resolution` | Review has identified issues or liens that are being resolved. |
| `released` | The product has successfully completed archive evaluation and has been publicly released through the archive. |
| `rejected` | The product did not satisfy requirements for archival acceptance. |

(controlled-values-archive-quality)=
### `archive_quality`

Records the assessment of a product against PDS archive quality requirements, including whether quality is satisfactory, needs improvement, is undetermined, or concerns a product intended for availability external to the formal archive.

Used in `Archive_Lifecycle_Status`.

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `satisfactory` | The product satisfies archive quality requirements. |
| `needs_improvement` | The product requires additional work before meeting archive quality requirements. |
| `external` | Product quality is indeterminate and is not intended for formal inclusion in the PDS archive and may be made available externally to the archive. |
| `undetermined` | Archive quality has not yet been determined. |

(controlled-values-validation-state)=
### `validation_state`

Records the outcome or availability of a validation assessment, indicating whether the product passed, passed with warnings, failed, has not been tested, or has an unknown result.

Used in `Validation_Assessment`.

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `passed` | The product passed the validation assessment. |
| `failed` | The product failed the validation assessment. |
| `passed_with_warnings` | The product passed validation but produced one or more warnings. |
| `not_tested` | The product has not been validated. |
| `unknown` | The validation result is not known. |
